site.title: AI Tech Hub
site.description: A collection of AI tech demos built with Nuxt v4.

speech.title: Speech
speech.description: Speech synthesis and recognition AI demos.

home.heroDescription: Speech, vision, NLP, AIGC, ML and Robotics demos. Most run in your browser — data stays on device, no sign-up. Cloud chat and online TTS work out of the box.
home.heroPrivacy: Data stays on your device by default
home.classroomDesc: Curated reliable demos: fast to load, great results — ideal for whole-class demos (teacher view)

step1.title: Pick a demo
step1.desc: Choose a capability from Speech, Vision, NLP, AIGC or ML.

step2.title: Prepare input
step2.desc: Most demos ship with sample assets — load one in one click, upload your own image / audio / text, or use the camera / mic live.

step3.title: Run and see
step3.desc: Hit Run to get instant results; parameters apply live, great for teaching in class.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.data: Where does my data go? Most demos run fully on-device — data never leaves your machine. Cloud chat and online TTS send data to those providers.
faq.device: What do I need? Any regular computer. Camera / mic demos need that hardware — otherwise use sample assets or upload instead.
faq.cloud: What needs the cloud? Cloud LLM chat and online TTS require a connection; all other browser demos work offline.
